Keto tip of the day: Kale

It's really good but it loses a lot of volume whilst cooking. Sarah Wilson also suggests to fry Kale in crisps.

Next time, I'll try these raw in a salad with salmon and olives.

I had never thought to fry kale before so I decided to experiment tonight and I have to say I don't know why anyone bakes kale. The fried kale chips were amazing! They hardly needed any prep I just tore them into the right size and threw them in a hot frying pan with some oil. I flipped them once and they were done in about a minute. Sprinkled on some lite salt and tried them and they were crisp before melting away in my mouth. Not chewy at all.

With all the trouble it is to get oven baked kale chips crisp without being soggy or chewy I honestly can't believe this is the first time I've heard of frying them.
